name: schedular
description: Automated College Timetable Generator - CACS452 Final Year Project

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run -w server dev" "npm run -w client dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w @schedular/shared build && npm run -w server build && npm run -w client build
scripts.setup: npm run -w server prisma:generate && npm run -w server db:push && npm run -w @schedular/shared build && npm run -w server seed
